sources.scope: Original real minute spot/perp and hourly mark archive provenance; normalized ns hashes checked.
Actual realized rates,settlement marks/timestamps. Official page redirects to current market-data catalog.
Existing unchanged isolated-ledger B0 engine and floating-quantity accounting;new horizon/fraction/OOS only.

accounting_scope: No historical L2/TCA or exchange liquidation tiers;frozen metadata and1%maintenance are declared proxies.
Original hourly equity retained;stronger full closed-minute traded-price plus post-fill NAV reconstructed independently;not minute mark-price NAV/intraminute extrema.
No real orders or changes to originalSMA orpaper10 accounts.
benchmark_scope: Same336day period;4500spot target/remaining cash is directional,not risk-matched carry. Benchmark rejected means reference-only,not necessarily negative return. Cash0yield comparator is analytic0.
